actions.name: Use
actions.area: creatures within a 30-ft.-radius spread centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates the howls and barks of a young black dragon
description.value: The caster emulates the howls and barks of a young black dragon. All creatures within a 30-foot spread except evil outsiders must succeed at a Will save or become panicked for 1d4 rounds. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected by the same spell for 24 hours. Learned From Black Dragon Family and (magical beast ones) saberclaws family.
